name: B10-0461/2025 (ESN) – Polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from the ESN Group. It does not change any law. It sets out the group's opinion on events in Serbia after the Novi Sad canopy collapse that killed 16 people. It defends the December 2023 election result, criticises violent protests, warns the EU against undermining Serbia's elected government, and calls for a "privileged partnership" instead of EU membership talks, which it says have failed.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a proposed statement of opinion, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Serbia's government and people, and EU institutions dealing with Serbia.
- **What happens next:** Other groups may respond; the Parliament may vote on a joint text.
